title: Jerry Jones spotted SLAMMING table and leaving seat early before Dallas Cowboys' embarrassing loss to Buccaneers on TNF - NewsBreak
text:
By Ryan Sanudo ,
34 minutes ago JERRY Jones couldn’t take watching his team lose to a winless team on national television.
The Cowboys owner left his suite early as the Tampa Bay Buccaneers won their first game against his team at AT&T Stadium on Thursday Night Football.
Prime Video’s cameras also captured Jones leaving his suite early before the Cowboys’ eventual defeat Credit: Prime Video The Bucs stunned the world with their upset victory over the Cowboys.
They did it behind undrafted rookie backup Jalon Daniels, who started his second career game with Baker Mayfield out with a thumb injury.
But the Cowboys were down just 26-14 in the final minute of the game, with their offense needing 24 yards to score a touchdown and potentially tie it.
However, Dak Prescott threw an interception to all but seal the victory for Tampa Bay, and Prime Video’s cameras captured Jones’ reaction.
The 83-year-old was shown in his suite taking his glasses off in disbelief at the interception.
Then, once Tampa Bay’s Bucky Irving ran for a first down to claim the win, Jones was spotted leaving his suite along with other front office members.
Prime Video even showed Jones’ real-time reaction to Prescott’s turnover, as the soon-to-be 84-year-old SLAMMED the desk in front of him.
NFL fans were quick to joke about Jones’ frustrated reaction to losing to an 0-4 team entering Thursday.

“Bro said “I’ve seen enough” and called it a night [laughing emojis],” one said on X.
“You might as well sell Jerry they ain’t winning anytime soon bud!” a second wrote.
“Jerry was like check please,” a third added.
“Jerry might have to fire someone,” a fourth stated.
